description: Runs of the S3 rerun that measure nothing and are excluded from every row; rerun on a fixed harness (queue-resume.txt lines 26, 31, 42 and 51). Measured by validity.txt; the cause is an inference from it and from the harness code.

runs.row: Hangul input, XToolkit with input-method events, plugin on
runs.measured: 23994 of 24000 steps delivered nothing and the host never showed in 11997 of 12000 trials; the 6 delivered steps are the first three sequences of trial 1, the last of them SPC /
runs.inferred: under Xvfb, with no window manager, the IDE frame loses the X input focus when the Find in Path dialog of SPC / closes; the harness ignored the 'no focus owner' answer of its input-method poster, so the trials looked like passes
